objectives.title: Data Rectification Mechanisms
objectives.description: The contract contains writings regarding correcting inaccurate personal data.
criteria: Provisions detailing the rectification of inaccurate data.
Mechanisms enabling data subject correction requests.

objectives.title: Completion of Incomplete Personal Data
objectives.description: The contract contains writings regarding completing incomplete records.
criteria: Provisions governing the completion of incomplete data.
Procedures assessing processing purposes during data completion.

objectives.title: Rectification Timelines
objectives.description: The contract contains writings regarding execution timelines for corrections.
criteria: Provisions specifying execution without undue delay.
Timeframes governing processor responses to correction instructions.
Confirmation to the controller upon completion of a correction within the specified timeframe.
